name: When should I consider rerouting plumbing lines during a vanity installation?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider rerouting plumbing lines during a vanity installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider rerouting plumbing lines during a vanity installation if the new vanity's design or size significantly differs from the old one, making the existing connections unsuitable. This is common when upgrading from a pedestal sink to a full vanity, or moving from a wall-mounted to a floor-standing unit. Rerouting may also be necessary if you're remodeling and want to achieve a cleaner look by concealing pipes, or if the current lines are corroded or improperly installed. This decision can impact the project's complexity and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rerouting plumbing is needed if your new vanity's design makes existing connections unsuitable, or for aesthetic and repair reasons.
